title: Crystal structure of MAGEA4 MHD-RAD18 R6BD reveals a flipped binding mode compared to AlphaFold2 prediction.
authors: Forker, Karly; Fleming, Matthew C; Pearce, Kenneth H; Vaziri, Cyrus; Bowers, Albert A; Zhou, Pei
one_liner_zh: 该文解析MAGEA4 MHD与RAD18 R6BD复合物晶体结构，揭示与AlphaFold2预测不同的结合模式，虽为蛋白-蛋白互作而非蛋白-DNA，但结构建模与预测方法对TF-DNA复合物建模有借鉴意义。
